name: @node-ctypes/python
description: Typed embedded CPython for Node.js, powered by node-ctypes
author: Damiano Mazzella

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:types && node --test --test-timeout=60000 --test-concurrency=1 "tests/src/*.test.ts"
scripts.test:mirror: npm run build && node -e "const { spawnSync } = require('node:child_process'); const r = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--test', '--test-timeout=60000', '--test-concurrency=1', 'tests/src/*.test.ts'], { stdio: 'inherit', env: { ...process.env, NODE_CTYPES_NO_EXTERNAL_BUFFERS: '1' } }); process.exit(r.status ?? 1);"
scripts.test:stress: npm run build && npm run test:types && node --test --test-concurrency=1 "tests/stress/*.test.ts"
scripts.test:backlog: npm run build && npm run test:types && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/stress/backlog.test.ts
